value.rationale: A complete natural subgroup-lattice classification for an important infinite family of equivariant topological data complexes: the fixed spaces are explicit 1-dimensional cubes, discrete spaces, or empty, distinguished by binary code diameter, despite the ambient three-sphere homotopy concentration. This determines integral fixed-space topology, not merely known Betti numbers or a minor numerical extension.
